visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed 2025 and 2010 local facade photographs and the ironwork close-up. Eight varied balcony tiers, pointed end gables, four dormers, four substantial chimneys, central roof and restored window finishes are represented. Review corrected central-bay faceting, upper central windows and a sign intersecting the bay.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views and the full final side/front view showing the hotel sign clear of the faceted bay. Brick, sandstone trim, painted metal and slate retain metric bindings; glass is local. The mapped three front projections and rear service projection agree with the overlay. Flat terrain here is a material fixture; independent terrain is preserved in the portable scene.

Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

Floral railing geometry and sign lettering are simplified original geometry; no photo pixels are embedded.
